answer: What stops an attacker minting 1,000 identities? Escrow and dispute slashing. Every new identity locks 240 units for 15 epochs. Anyone can challenge within 3 epochs, and a 9-member jury decides within 2. How is a fake caught? The jury checks proofs, and a fake loses 80% of its stake. Who pays? The challenger keeps 25% of the slash, and the fake is banned 12 epochs. The river check traces funds, the forge stamp marks verified work, and the horizon caps re-entry. What do 1,000 clones cost? 240,000 units locked; a 30% catch rate slashes 57,600, and 14,400 go to challengers.
